description: Implement list_items, show_item, ready, stats, deps, deferrals, export, check_scope, verify_list (list stored verifications, never run them), lint, and start_unit (no-shell state change) as read-only or no-shell tools in the default profile. list_items, ready, and show_item carry fields and limit. Oversized list output uses the drop-trailing-items paging fallback before E_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED. stats returns a coded error when project identity is unresolved.

preserves.behavior: Query tools open a read-only connection and never resolve a read-write credential
verify_list never executes a stored verification command

work_units.summary: Confirm the read-only and no-shell tracker methods behind each tool
